channel.botTokenEncryptedHint: Token will be encrypted and stored securely.
channel.botTokenInvalid.discord: This does not look like a Discord bot token. Reset and copy it from the Bot tab of your Discord app — it is three segments separated by dots.
channel.botWakeAllowChannelsEmpty: No limit — the bot may join anywhere in scope.
channel.botWakeAllowChannelsHint: Channel or thread IDs where the bot may join. Leave empty for no limit.
channel.botWakeClassifierInitiateEnabled: When someone asks the bot something without naming or @-mentioning it, for example in a channel people use it in, the bot answers if the message is plainly for it.
channel.botWakeClassifierInitiateThresho: How sure the bot must be that a message nobody addressed to it is for it before it answers, from 0 to 1. A higher value makes it answer less often.
channel.botWakeClassifierThresholdHint: Right after the bot replied, how sure it must be that a message is still for it before it joins, from 0 to 1. A higher value makes it join less often.
channel.botWakeCollectSecondsHint: How long a burst is collected before the bot answers. At least 20.
channel.botWakeCooldownSecondsHint: Quiet time after a run before the next one may start. At least 60.
channel.botWakeCustomInstructionsEnabled: Tell the bot in your own words whom to answer and what to leave alone. Turn on to write them.
channel.botWakeCustomInstructionsHint: Written to the bot like a prompt: who it should answer, what to leave alone, examples of each. It guides the judgement and is not a hard rule. Up to 4000 characters.
channel.botWakeCustomInstructionsPlaceho:
Answer when someone asks about billing, refunds or invoices, or follows up on something you said.
Stay out of casual chat between teammates and of messages addressed to someone else.
If a message mentions you only in passing, do not reply.
channel.botWakeDenyChannelsHint: Channel or thread IDs where the bot never joins. Takes priority over allowed channels.
channel.botWakeEnabledHint: Turns on the wake options below. The bot judges messages nobody addressed to it and may join in; off keeps today's behavior, where a watch keyword wakes the bot without any check.
channel.botWakeMaxSilentWakesHint: After this many wakes in a row where the bot chose to stay silent, it stops joining until it speaks again. 0 means no limit.
channel.botWakeOwnerPresenceSecondsHint: If the bot's owner posted in the channel within this time, the bot stays quiet. 0 turns this off.
channel.botWakePaceActiveHint: Keeps up for 10 minutes after it speaks and joins even while you are around.
channel.botWakePaceBalancedHint: Follows up for 5 minutes after it speaks and stays quiet for 2 minutes after you do.
channel.botWakePaceCalmHint: Joins rarely: a short follow-up window, quiet while you are around, and a burst of messages gets one reply.
channel.botWakePaceCustomHint: Set the follow-up window, silence limit, owner presence and batching yourself.
channel.botWakePaceHint: How often the bot speaks up on its own. Pick a preset, or Custom to set the numbers.
channel.botWakeProactiveEnabledHint: When you raise something the bot could help with (a problem, a complaint, a plan) without calling it, the bot judges whether to step in with a concrete proposal. Only your own messages count, and it may still stay silent.
channel.botWakeProactiveThresholdHint: How sure the bot must be that you would welcome its help before it steps in, from 0 to 1. A higher value makes it step in less often.
channel.botWakeSchedulerEnforceHint: Messages are collected, then answered together.
channel.botWakeSchedulerModeHint: Hold follow-ups briefly and answer a burst of messages in one run instead of one run per message. Has no effect on deployments without a job queue.
channel.botWakeScopeAllHint: Any channel or thread the bot can read.
channel.botWakeScopeBotThreadsHint: A channel or thread where the bot posted within the follow-up window. Discord counts a channel and its threads as one place.
channel.botWakeScopeHint: Limits the places where the bot may join unprompted.
channel.botWakeWindowSecondsHint: After the bot speaks, plain messages in the same place within this time count as a follow-up to it.
channel.charLimitHint: Maximum number of characters per message

channel.concurrencyDebounceHint: Only process the last message in a burst (earlier ones are dropped)
channel.concurrencyQueueHint: Process messages one at a time
